mapper.select: SELECT tm.ID AS MESSAGE_ID, tm.SENDER_MEMBER_ID AS SENDER_MEMBER_ID, me.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, tm.CONTENT AS CONTENT, tm.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, tm.UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT FROM TEAM_MESSAGE tm JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = tm.SENDER_MEMBER_ID WHERE tm.CHALLENGE_ID = #{challengeId} AND tm.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR tm.ID < #{cursor}) ORDER BY tm.ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE TEAM_MESSAGE SET CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
UPDATE TEAM_MESSAGE SET DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEAM_MESSAGE (CHALLENGE_ID, SENDER_MEMBER_ID, CONTENT) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{senderMemberId}, #{content})
